semanticConstraints: Local literal presentation paths cannot overlap native authentication/API/control prefixes. Native CShells rejects route collisions before generation publication.
Native LogoutLandingPath must equal RoutePrefix plus /signed-out. BFF browser actions reuse native authentication and antiforgery.
Application name, locale and bounded copy are encoded as text. Only known copy keys are accepted.
Theme must be the owning application blue, green or slate token. Static stylesheet variants preserve encoded markup and light/dark contrast; no inline style or unreviewed CSS is admitted.

Locale is the fallback. Locales maps canonical cultures to bounded known copy keys; positive Accept-Language weights and parent cultures select a catalog. Missing translations retain Copy/English defaults.
The optional IBrowserRecoveryPageRenderer receives admitted native controls; native antiforgery/session/logout behavior and machine errors remain unchanged.
